Bytebox help menu:

<> - Required argument
[] - Optional elements

help - show this menu

read - print the entire database

get/
    get <row> <column>    - print an element from the database
    getcol <column>       - print a column from the database
    getrow <row>          - print a row from the database

add/
    add [elements]        - add a new row to the database
    addcol <column_name>  - add a new column to the database

set/
    set <row> <column> <value> - replace an element in the database
    setrow <row> <value...>    - replace a row in the database
    setcol <column> <value...> - replace a column in the database

delete/
    delete <row> <column> - clear an element in the database
    delrow <row>          - clear a row in the database
    delcol <column>       - delete a column from the database
